chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said:
Indeed, a man may spend his wealth in a rightful cause, yet he is still extravagant.

key_terms.فِي حَقٍّ: in a rightful or legitimate cause
key_terms.لَمُسْرِفٌ: truly extravagant; one who exceeds proper bounds

ai.seo_question: Can a person be considered extravagant even when spending wealth on a rightful cause?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that extravagance is not defined only by spending on falsehood or sin. Even spending on something rightful can become excess when it goes beyond proper limits and balance.
